verdict.rationale: Orama's core search engine is an open-source library you run inside your own app, browser, or Deno runtime at no cost (orama-docs-12, orama-gh-6), and its APIs mirror Orama Cloud so projects can move between Cloud and open source (orama-docs-19). Orama also offers on-premise deployment of the Cloud context server, run in your cloud or on-prem (orama-docs-8, orama-docs-51), though this appears tied to an enterprise, engineer-assisted offering rather than a documented do-it-yourself path. Missing for 10: a documented self-host deployment guide for the Cloud/context server, an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration, and a self-hosted alternative to the Cloud Secure Proxy that AnswerSession relies on (orama-docs-18).
